description: This file defines Express routes for session management, including tenant listing, tenant selection, and toggling global tenant filters. It incorporates middleware for authentication and authorization, interacts with audit logs, and handles setting cookies and custom headers related to tenant context.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Returns the list of tenants associated with the authenticated user, with audit logging

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in the session by setting a cookie after RBAC validation and logs the change

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias for setting the active tenant, reusing the /tenant handler

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Toggles a global 'all tenants' mode for the session, only accessible by Super Admin, with audit logging
